## basic IV example


```{r}
ivdag <- graph_from_literal(V1 -+ V2 -+ V3, U1 -+ V2:V3) |> initialize_graph()
dag_list_independences(ivdag)

ivrels <- dag_get_linear_relations(ivdag)
hrepiv <- cf_relations_to_hrep(ivrels$probform, ivrels$relation)
```

```{r}
hrep <- hrepiv$Hrep[[1]]
d <- 8
equalities <- hrep[ , 1] == "1"
av <- scdd(hrep[equalities, ])$output
av.point <- av[av[ , 1] == "0", ]
av.lines <- av[av[ , 1] == "1", ]
av.point <- as.vector(av.point[- c(1, 2)])
av.lines <- av.lines[ , - c(1, 2)]
av.point
av.lines

m <- t(av.lines)
lambda.zero <- (av.point)
x <- (1:d)
as.vector(rbind(rep(1, d)) %*% m)
as.vector(rbind(x) %*% m)
```


```{r}
library(causaloptim)
ivmod <- create_causalmodel(causaloptim::initialize_graph(graph_from_literal(V1 -+ V2 -+ V3, Ur -+ V2:V3)),
                            prob.form = list(cond = "V1", out = c("V2", "V3")))

probs <- sample_distribution(ivmod)

d1 <- rmultinom(1, 500, probs[1:4])
d2 <- rmultinom(1, 500, probs[5:8])

lambda.hat <- c(d1, d2)/ 500

lout <- lm(lambda.hat - lambda.zero ~ 0 + m,
    weights = 1 / lambda.hat)
beta.star <- lout$coefficients
varmat <- solve(t(m) %*% diag(1 / lambda.hat) %*% m) / 500

library(MASS)
nboot <- 15
beta <- mvrnorm(nboot, beta.star, varmat)
lambda <- beta %*% t(m)
lambda <- sweep(lambda, 2, lambda.zero, "+")
```
